Commentary.Commentary: Right then! We have witnessed yet another nail-biter in this series. India have managed to win both the games and have secured the series. But we still have one more game to go in this enticing series, and the way the matches are going, we can expect yet another cliff-hanger. The third ODI will be played on Wednesday, 27th July, and it is all set to begin at 7.00 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Do tune in early for the build-up. For now, it's goodbye!

Shikhar Dhawan the captain of India says it was a team performance. Adds the boys always believed and everybody played really well, even the 11 runs from Avesh Khan at the end was amazing. States their domestic cricket is quite strong and it makes a huge impact and when one performs there, it gives them confidence, and the mindset matters a lot. Mentions they felt they restricted West Indies well as they got off to a very good start but they knew they can chase it, they started slow but they always believed. Ends by thanking the support staff too for their effort and also credits Shai Hope for the way he played and congratulates him for scoring a ton on this 100th game.

Nicholas Pooran the skipper of West Indies says they did not hold their nerve. He felt like India played really well and they lost the game in the last few overs. Adds he felt they could bowl the spinners with 5 out, they felt the spinners were easier to hit but they needed just the one wicket but Axar Patel played well. Adds Hope played really well, they want to keep improving, this is a tough loss to take but they want to win the next game.

Axar Patel is the Player of the Match. He says that it's a very special knock, considering the situation he was batting in. Mentions that he knew he needed 11 runs per over and they had done it earlier in the Indian T20 League and he knew he can do it again. Says that he is playing an ODI game after 2017, and he is feeling wonderful after such a knock that helped his side get over the line.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, West Indies put up a score which we felt was above par slightly, courtesy of a ton from Hope and a fine knock from their skipper Pooran. India though chased it down thanks to good knocks from Samson and Iyer but the hero for them was Axar Patel. He helped INDIA CLINCH THE SERIES WITH A GAME TO GO!

The Windies were brilliant till the 40th over but it was the last 10 where everything fell apart for them. Before that, the likes of Alzarri Joseph, Kyle Mayers, Jayden Seales were excellent but in the last 10, it just did not go as per their plan. Akeal Hosein had a day to forget, Alzarri Joseph was not that great at the slog overs. Romario Shepherd too proved to be expensive. Kyle Mayers was given the onus to bow the final over but it was too much to ask of from him. Pooran will be very disappointed with how things ended.

For most parts, the hosts were on top! Defending a really good total, they began brilliantly with the ball. They did not let India score freely and had them three down before 100. Shreyas Iyer and Samson then steadied the ship with a 99-run stand. Iyer scored a half-ton but just as the game seemed to be moving in India's direction, Iyer fell. Samson also did not last for long after he got to his half-ton and at that moment, the game was completely in favor of the hosts. The visitors needed around 100 in the last 10 but Hooda and Axar Patel did not give up. The two added 50 in no time and got India back into the game. Hooda fell but Axar Patel continued. He played a once-in-a-lifetime knock, as he scored an unbeaten 64 off 35 balls and took his side over the line brilliantly.

Contrasting emotions out there! The Indians are celebrating and West Indies just can't believe they have lost this game! Take a bow, Axar Patel, he was the one who took the game away from the Windies. This though is going to be a tough one to swallow for the Windies, a really tough one to swallow. As they say, winning is a habit, and losing is one and the Windies just can't win a game at the moment.

SIX! BANG! Axar Patel finishes things off in style! Kyle Mayers goes for the yorker again, but he misses his length this time. He serves a full toss, outside off. Axar Patel slams this one over long off for a biggie! West Indies players stand there in disbelief! India win by 2 wickets!
Another yorker, outside off this time. Mohammed Siraj opens the face of the bat guides it towards point.
A yorker again, on the pads this time. Axar Patel flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. Only a single. 7 off 4 balls now!
A perfect start for West Indies! A yorker, outside off. Axar Patel fails to dig this one out. 8 needed off 5 balls now.

8 needed from the last over! Two wickets in hand but we believe Axar will want to do it by himself. Who will bowl the last over? It is Kyle Mayers who has been given the ball. Excellent from Axar as he did not cross on the last ball when the catch was taken. Can Kyle Mayers get his team over the line? He has had a really good day with the ball but is this too much to ask from him?

OUT! TAKEN! Avesh Khan goes for a big shot once again but this time he holes out! Jayden Seales drops it short once again, around middle, slower as well. Avesh Khan pulls this one, but the ball goes off the top edge and flies high towards deep square leg. Shamarh Brooks settles under it and takes a good catch. India need 8 runs off the last over!
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Jayden Seales

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter one, around middle and off. Avesh Khan swings his bat hard at it but he misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Axar Patel plays a controlled pull shot towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Avesh Khan miscues his pull shot towards mid-wicket for a single. 9 off 9 now!
FOUR! Crunched! Avesh Khan connects this one! Full and wide of off. Avesh Khan slaps this one wide of long off for a boundary. 10 runs off 10 balls needed.
A single off the first ball! A fuller ball, on the pads. Axar Patel flicks it towards deep square leg and gives the strike to Avesh Khan!

Another wild swing and another dot ball! This is a fuller one, around middle and off. Avesh Khan looks to hoick this one but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto the pads. 15 runs needed off 12 balls now.
Shorter ball, outside off. Avesh Khan swings his bat wildly at it, but he misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Axar Patel drives it towards cover for a single.
Pitches it up now, around middle. Avesh Khan drags it with the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket. Another single.
Wide! Very short on this occasion, wide of off. Avesh Khan leaves it alone. Wide called!
A precious dot for West Indies! Slower one, short and outside off. Avesh Khan looks to pull this but he fails to get any connection on that.
Single to begin with! Fuller one, around middle and off. Axar Patel drives it down the ground. The ball deflects off Alzarri Joseph's leg and goes towards mid-wicket for a single.
Two dots in a row now! Outside off, full again. Avesh Khan once again drives it but straight to the fielder at cover. 19 needed off 18 balls now.
Full, outside off, Avesh Khan makes room and drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Avesh Khan gets in the act as well! Short and wide of off. Avesh Khan makes room and slaps this over mid off for a boundary. Less than run a ball is required for India now!
On a length, darting it on the pads. Axar Patel flicks it towards square leg for a single.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR AXAR PATEL! A fuller ball, on the pads. Axar Patel whips it towards deep mid-wicket for another boundary in the over! What a knock this has been from him. He is playing a match-winning knock. He brings up his maiden half-ton in ODIs in just 27 balls!

FOUR! EDGY RUNS! But India will not mind that! Agony for West Indies though! Shorter one, around middle and off. Axar Patel pulls this but the ball goes off the top edge towards third man for a boundary.

A mix-up in the middle, but no harm done! A length ball, around off. Avesh Khan knocks it towards mid on. He leaves his crease to steal a single, but Axar Patel sends him back since it was the last ball of the over. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. 32 needed off 24 balls now!

OUT! TAKEN! Alzarri Joseph has the last laugh here! This will surely help West Indies! Shardul Thakur looks to go bit but he holes out! A short ball, wide of off. Shardul Thakur hops and cuts it aerially towards deep point. The ball goes off his outer and half and flies towards the fielder there. Shamarh Brooks takes an easy catch. Game on!
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, around middle. Axar Patel knocks it down to long on for a single.

NO BALL AND BYE! Another full toss, down the leg side. Shardul Thakur looks to pull this one but he misses. Shai Hope once again, fails to grab the ball cleanly and the batters cross ends. Free Hit continues!

No ball and Bye! Oh, dear! West Indies are giving it away here! A full toss, outside off. Axar Patel throws his bat it but he misses. Shai Hope fumbles to collect the ball and the batters cross end. A no ball is called! Free Hit coming up!
SIX! Oh, glorious! Axar Patel is playing a gem of an innings here! Full and in the slot, around off. Axar Patel tonks this straight down the ground all the way for a biggie!
Much fuller now outside off. Shardul Thakur drives it down to long off for a single.

FOUR BYES! This will help India! A length ball down the leg side. Shardul Thakur looks to flick this one but he misses. The ball goes off his thigh pads and towards fine leg for a boundary. Perfect start for India!
Shortish again and outside off, Thakur slaps it through covers for one.
Axar is not happy with himself! This is tossed up outside off, Axar looks to play the slog sweep, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for another single.
FOUR! Up and over! Really good shot. Axar is not giving up here! Shorter and outside off, Axar hits it over point and this one trickles over the fence. Handy boundary. 50 needed now.
On off, Thakur gets Patel back on strike by taking a single as he hits it down to long off.
Fires this outside off, Patel looks to play the slog sweep but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one. Windies won't mind this as it gets Patel off strike.
Shardul Thakur walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! That is some courage, some courage shown by Pooran! Let me tell you, we here felt this was a big risk, giving Akeal Hosein the ball who has not had a good time but he gets Hooda. Yes, it was Axar Patel who has got the better of Akeal Hosein but Hooda is a huge wicket too. He was the one who India were relying on. Windies back on top. Hooda steps out, this is tossed up outside off. Hooda does not get to the pitch of it but still looks to go over covers. It turns away, it goes off the outer half and it is a simple catch for Hayden Walsh at point.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayden Walsh b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Single to finish! Another productive over for India! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. 56 in 36. Game is in the balance now.
That is brilliant running! A yorker on the pads, this is jammed out towards mid-wicket. Two taken in no time.
Pressure, pressure telling on Windies! A misfield! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg. The fielder lets it through. Two taken.
Full and on the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one more.
Shorter and on the body, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Alzarri Joseph (7-1-24-1) is brought back into the attack.
Now a single to end! Just the 64 needed in 42. India well and truly in this one! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.

SIX! What a shot! Axar Patel is turning it on for the Indians here! On middle, right in the slot again. He hits it with the turn and over the long on fence. Once again India finding a boundary when they need one.
Another one! Outside off, this is hit towards sweeper cover for one.
Fuller and on middle, Patel hits it out to deep square leg for one more. Singles won't bother the Windies.
Was that a chance? A very tough one! Tossed up outside off, Hooda looks to go over covers, it goes off the outside edge, hits the outer half part of the glove of the keeper and goes behind for one.
That was there to be hit! It was fired on the pads, Patel swings, it goes off the inner half, past short fine leg for one.
A single to end but the damage was done earlier on! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A full toss now on the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! EDGY! India won't mind how they come as long as they do! This is short and begging to be hit! Deepak Hooda throws his bat at it, it goes off the outside edge and over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Bowls a low full toss outside off, this is carved towards deep cover for one.
SIX! BANG! Down the ground! Axar is keeping India's hopes alive! This is right in the slot. Full and on off, this is hammered down the ground and over the long off fence.
How has that not hurt? Pretty sure he is hiding the pain! Fuller and on off, this is smashed back towards the bowler, Shepherd stops it with his leg. He saves a boundary.
WIDE! Extras will help! This is well wide outside off, left alone.
Leg bye to end but a good over for India! Axar steps out but the length is shortened. He looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken. 89 needed in 54.
SIX! BANG! That is what India need and more of it. This is a hit-me delivery. Short and down the leg side. Axar pulls it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Really well bowled! Sees Hooda dance down the track, bowls it shorter and outside off. Hooda chops it on the off side for one.
Fires it into middle, this is pulled but not timed that well towards deep square leg for one.
Well fielded! Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point. The fielder dives to his right and saves at least two.

NOT OUT! Patel is in! He was late to take off but makes it in! On middle, this is worked to short fine leg. Hooda wants a run, Patel is late in taking off. The throw is towards Akeal Hosein. It hits his hand and rolls onto the stumps. It is taken upstairs but replays show that Patel is in.
Time for Powerplay 3! Now, a total of 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle.
Full and around middle and leg. Axar Patel flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short again, width on offer. Deepak Hooda skips down the pitch and slaps it towards deep cover for a single.
Another pull shot once again that's not in the gap! Short and on middle. Axar Patel pulls it to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball now, around middle and leg. Deepak Hooda flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Axar Patel pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter, outside off. Axar Patel looks to pull this but the ball goes off his bottom edge and bounces before the keeper.
Short on this occasion, around middle. Axar Patel pulls it towards square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Very full now, aroun middle. Deepak Hooda drives it down to long on for a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! India loses their set batter. This is not what India needed right now. But West Indies are elated! A length ball, around the thigh pad. Sanju Samson tucks it towards the fielder at short fine leg and he scampers across to the other end. Kyle Mayers collects the ball and throws it back to the bowler. Romario Shepherd fails to grab the ball, but the ball hits his shin and goes onto the stumps. Sanju Samson is nowhere near! He has to depart after a fine knock.
On a length, outside off. Deepak Hooda drives this one on the up towards cover for a single.
Romario Shepherd drops it short now, tad slower as well. Sanju Samson pulls this one from outside off towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
A low full toss, around middle. Deepak Hooda advances down the pitch, opens the face of the bat and drives it towards cover for a single.
A length delivery, outside off. Sanju Samson punches it firmly but finds the fielder at cover.
Leg bye! Jayden Seales serves a good-length delivery, on the pads. Deepak Hooda looks to flick this one but he misses. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
Back of a length, outside off. Deepak Hooda pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Angling in, on a good length, around middle and leg. Sanju Samson tucks it through square leg and takes a single.

FOUR! Easy pickings! A full toss, around the thigh pad. Sanju Samson tickles it fine towards fine leg for a boundary. He brings up his maiden ODI half-ton with that. A fine knock till now, but he will know his job is only half done here! Also, that brings up the 200 for India.
Pitched up delivery, around middle. Deepak Hooda drives it to long on for a single.
Fuller one, around middle. Deepak Hooda works it away towards mid-wicket and takes a single. India needs 117 runs off 78 balls.
On a good length this time, around middle and off. Sanju Samson strokes it to long on and rotates the strike.
Much fuller now, around middle. Deepak Hooda knocks it down to long on for yet another single.
Width on offer now, slightly short. Sanju Samson cuts it past point for a run.
A length delivery, outside off. Deepak Hooda looks to push this away on the off side, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Romario Shepherd pitches it up now, around middle. Deepak Hooda closes the face of the bat and pushes it towards mid-wicket.

DRINKS! One can say the game right now is in the favor of the hosts! They would know if they manage to break this stand, they will be into the all-rounders. Also, the run rate needed now is almost touching 9 so the pressure is totally on the Indians at the moment. Samson and Hooda need to play out another 8 to 10 overs if India are going to have any kind of chance. Can they pull it off? It will be an amazing feat if they do.
Another short-pitched delivery, around middle. Deepak Hooda pulls it and finds the fielder at deep square leg. Only a single!
Sticks to his length, serves it short and outside off. Deepak Hooda stays in his crease and dabs it towards short third man.
Back of a length, around middle. Deepak Hooda looks to pull this one but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat and towards mid-wicket.
Another shoter ball, outside off. Sanju Samson guides it down to third man for a single.
Shorter one again, outside off. Sanju Samson hops and dabs it towards cover.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Deepak Hooda miscues his pull shot towards deep square leg for a single.
Pitches it up, around off. Deepak Hooda advances down the pitch and knocks it down to long off for a single.
Fuller one, around middle. Deepak Hooda steps down the pitch and works it away towards mid-wicket.
Slightly short now, outside off, spinning away. Deepak Hooda stays in his crease and cuts it past point for a brace.
Fuller one, around off. Deepak Hooda drives it towards cover.
FOUR! Deepak Hooda gets off the mark in style! A fuller one, around off. Deepak Hooda presses forward and goes inside-out over cover for a boundary.
Shorter delivery, outside off, spinning away. Sanju Samson knocks it off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Another back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Deepak Hooda looks to cut this away but he gets a bottom edge back onto the deck. Excellent over from Jayden Seales! Just 1 run off it.
Back of a length, outside off. Deepak Hooda pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
On a good length now, outside off. Deepak Hooda opens the face of the bat and guides it towards backward point.
Good-length delivery, around middle, at 133 clicks. Deepak Hooda pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter one now, outside off. Sanju Samson hangs back and taps it towards short third man. Single taken!
Fullish delivery, outside off. Sanju Samson blocks it out towards cover.
Deepak Hooda walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Alzarri Joseph breaks this partnership! Much-needed wicket for West Indies. This is another big wicket for the hosts. A yorker-length delivery, around the leg pole, at 144 clicks. Shreyas Iyer looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Shreyas Iyer opts for a review immediately. Nothing on the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicates that it is the umpire's call on the wicket's hitting. The on-field decision stands. Shreyas Iyer has to depart after yet another fine knock.
On a length, outside off. Sanju Samson guides it down to third man for a run.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short now, around middle. Shreyas Iyer pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a run.
On a length, outside off. Sanju Samson stays in his crease and steers it down to third man for another run.
Much fuller now, around middle. Shreyas Iyer closes the face of the bat and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Shorter one, outside off. Shreyas Iyer rocks back and dabs it to the fielder at point.
Flatter now, quicker, around middle and leg. Sanju Samson looks to flick this one but he gets a leading edge away from the bowler.
SIX! Up and away! Fuller this time, around off. Sanju Samson shimmies down the pitch and plays this inside-out over cover for a biggie! Lovely shot!
Spinning away, outside off, shortish ball. Sanju Samson pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length again, around middle and off. Shreyas Iyer knocks it down to long on off the back foot. Single taken!
Shorter now, spinning away, around off. Sanju Samson pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a quick single.
Flatter and on the pads. Shreyas Iyer stays in crease and tucks through square leg for a single.

Quick single! Slightly short now, around off. Shreyas Iyer miscues his pull shot towards mid on and scampers across to the other end. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Iyer was well in.
On a length, outside off. Sanju Samson dabs it towards cover-point and takes a single.
Back of a length now, around middle. Shreyas Iyer swivels and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Make that three dots in a row! Much fuller, around off, at 129 clicks. Shreyas Iyer drives it back to the bowler.
On a length now, outside off again. Shreyas Iyer guides it towards backward point. Hayden Walsh there does well to stop the ball. Back-to-back dot balls!
A fuller ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer taps it towards the fielder at point.
Alzarri Joseph is back on!

FOUR! That is a huge over and probably the one which shifts the momentum into India's favor. Just the 150 more needed in 120 balls. Short and down the leg side. Samson helps it on its way over the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. Just the 154 needed now. India back into the game.

SIX! Over the fence! What a shot that is. Brilliant. Fuller and right in the slot. The slower one does not come out right. It is hit well over the long off fence. 11 from the over with two balls to go.
Fuller and on off, Iyer drives but to mid off.

FOUR! Just wide! Iyer in full flow now! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled past mid-wicket for a boundary. FIfty for Iyer. He will know only half the job is done. He started off slowly but is now catching up.
Really well fielded! On the pads, Samson flicks it towards short fine leg. Akeal Hosein dives and stops it. Just the one.
A single to end then! On off, this is pushed through covers for one. Good comeback by the bowler after going for a boundary early on.
Length and on middle, Iyer pushes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Fractionally short and outside off, Iyer slaps it hard but to covers.
WIDE! This is way too short. Iyer evades it well.
Good length and on off, Iyer looks to drop and run but is sent back in time.
Bangs it short again, this time it is outside off. Iyer looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! That has been pulled brilliantly! The over starts with a boundary and pressure now on Shepherd! Short and on middle, this is thumped through mid-wicket. No chance of stopping that.
Another easy single! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Another single! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Does well to get a hand to it! Fuller and on off, this is hit back hard towards the bowler who does make a half stop. A single.
On middle, Samson works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Fuller and on off, Samson pushes it to mid off.

Not sure why there was not a louder appeal! Maybe an inside edge! On off, shortish. Samson looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pads. Not a lot of bounce on this wicket. Could have been a better appeal.
Two to end! Iyer moving along nicely now! Shorter and outside off, this is cut past point for two.
Misfield and one! On off, this is pushed towards cover, the fielder lets it through and an easy run is taken.
Darts it on off, Samson pushes it to covers.
This time he plays it past the player at the mid-wicket region for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Deft! Fires it on off, Iyer guides it past short third man for two.
Akeal Hosein (3-0-20-0) is brought back into the attack.
Another single to end! Mayers continues to keep it tidy! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket.
Another one as this is nudged through mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Iyer works it through square leg and a single is taken.
Good shot but only one! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Length and on off, Samson guides it to short third man.
Another easy single! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Kyle Mayers (4-0-15-2) is back on!
Another single to end! Back-to-back good overs for India. They need 188 from 150 balls. The last ball is on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Drop and run! Good length and on off, Samson pushes it towards cover for one.
Lovely shot for one! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Iyer has started to find his timing! Length and on off, he times it well but to covers.

FOUR LEG BYES! Runs now have started to flow! Hope should have done better there though. On the pads, Iyer looks to flick, it goes off the pad, Hope dives over the ball and this races away to the fence.
Angled into middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Sensible batting now! Follows the biggie with a single as this is worked through mid-wicket. 12 from the over. India need a few more of these to release the pressure.

SIX! That is a glorious hit and India now need below 200. This is tunring out to be a brilliant over for the visitors. This is tossed up, way too full, it is lofted over the long off fence for a biggie.
Flatter and on off, a little but of turn. Samson pushes it to covers.
Iyer will be disappointed he did not put that away! A full toss on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! A poor ball and India can't miss out these. Shorter and down the leg side, this is pulled through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.

DRINKS! West Indies are well in control of the game for now. A couple of wickets for them will help them inch closer towards victory. Shreyas Iyer and Sanju Samson are doing some damage work for India at the moment. They need to build a big partnership here and get their side back in the game.
Another dot! So despite the boundary, only 5 from it. On a length and around off, this is guided to point.
Length again and on off, Samson pushes it to covers.
Iyer loses his bat! Sweaty palms maybe! On middle, Iyer looks to flick, he loses his bat in the process but does connect, it goes through square leg for one.
FOUR! 100 up for India! Iyer loves that area and he finally puts one away. Will this get him going? Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point for a boundary.
Angled into middle, Iyer pushes it to covers.
No foot movement! Length and outside off, Iyer throws his bat at it, gets beaten!
Romario Shepherd (3-0-16-1) comes back to bowl.
Really good stuff from Walsh! Flatter and outside off, a little bit of turn away. Left alone by Samson.
Just the one again! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for a single.
Down the leg side, Samson works it towards square leg for one.
Looks to break the shackles, steps out and looks to go inside out over covers, it goes off the inner half down to long on for one.
The pressure continues to build! On middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Another dot! Pressure building on Iyer! On middle, he pushes it towards the left of mid-wicket who runs there and stops it.
Another one on the shorter side, this is nudged towards square leg for one. Another excellent over from Joseph.
This one is shorter, it skids through. Iyer is rushed into a pull, it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Angled into middle, Iyer defends. 4 dots in this over so far.
Shorter and outside off, comes slow off the surface and hence, Iyer ends up chopping it to point.
A short one, going to see a lo of that being bowled to Iyer. He evades it.
Length and on off, this one shapes back in. Iyer looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Sanju Samson presses forward and defends it out.
SIX! KABOOM! Hayden Walsh overpitches this one, outside off again, loopy ball. Sanju Samson makes room and slams this over wide long off all the way for a biggie.
Well bowled! Slower through the air, full in length. This one lands around off and spins away. Sanju Samson leans forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tosses it up, full and on middle. Sanju Samson presses forward and blocks it out.
Much fuller now, outside off. Shreyas Iyer slices it uppishly towards deep cover. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Single taken!
Shorter one, outside off. Shreyas Iyer chops it past point. Two taken!
Hayden Walsh comes into the attack!
Fuller now, outside off. Sanju Samson drives and finds the fielder at mid off. Another terrific over from West Indies!
Back of a length, outside off. Sanju Samson opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
On the pads now, a length ball. Shreyas Iyer flicks it off the back foot towards fine leg for a single.
Another short ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer ducks underneath it.
Shorter one, around middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer looks to pull this but the ball goes off his forearm and towards the keeper.

Excellant stop! West Indies are not letting anything get away! A fuller one, outside off. Sanju Samson drives it towards cover. Nicholas Pooran dives to his left and makes a terrific stop. Single taken. He saved three runs there.
Another length ball, on the pads. Sanju Samson flicks it towards square leg for a single. Another successful over from Kyle Mayers comes to an end.
On a length, around middle. Sanju Samson blocks it out.

IN THE AIR...AND SAFE! A length ball, on the pads. Sanju Samson flicks this one but the ball goes off the leading edge and falls just away from Brandon King at mid-wicket. He did put in a dive but he failed to get there.
FOUR! Sanju Samson is off the mark with a boundary! A length ball, down the leg side. Sanju Samson flick it fine, towards fine leg for a boundary.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Two wickets in two overs for Kyle Mayers! He gets rid of Suryakumar Yadav now! This is a big wicket for West Indies! Kyle Mayers serves it slightly short, wide of off. Suryakumar Yadav stays in his crease and looks to push this away on the off side. But the ball goes off the inside edge back onto the stumps. India are 3 down and in a spot of bother for now.
Sanju Samson comes to the crease.
Wide! Down the leg side, on a length. Suryakumar Yadav looks to flick this but he misses. Wide called!
Pitches it up, around off. Suryakumar Yadav drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Back of a length, width on offer, spinning away. Shreyas Iyer rocks back and cuts it past backward point for a brace. Good over for India! 11 runs off it!
Much fuller now, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav drives it down to long off for a run.
Back of a length, around off. Suryakumar Yadav blocks it out towards cover off the back foot.
Outside off, full again. Shreyas Iyer dabs it towards point and takes a single.
Flatter one, full and around off. Suryakumar Yadav drives it towards deep cover for a single.
SIX! Suryakumar Yadav takes on Akeal Hosein! A fuller one, around middle. Suryakumar Yadav clears his front leg and flicks it over deep long on for a biggie! Lovely shot!
Another length ball, on the pads. Suryakumar Yadav flicks it towards deep square leg for a single. He gets off the mark!
Outside off, on a length. Suryakumar Yadav pushes this one towards point.
Suryakumar Yadav walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Kyle Mayers strikes and he sends back the other Indian opener. A soft dismissal! This was a fuller ball, around off. Shubman Gill gets low and looks to scoop this over. But the ball goes off the toe end and lobs up towards the bowler. Kyle Mayers takes an easy catch there. The pressure was building on and Shubman Gill could not hold on!
Good-length delivery, around middle and off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it towards long on for a single.
On a length now, around middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket again. No run there!
Back of a length, around middle and off. Shreyas Iyer pulls it along the ground towards mid-wicket.
Short again, outside off. Shubman Gill cuts it this time but straight to the fielder at cover. Another tidy over for West Indies!
Swing and a miss! Quicker this time at 95 clicks, short as well and outside off. Shubman Gill rocks back and looks to cut this away but he misses.
Shorter, darting it around the pads. Shreyas Iyer stays in his crease and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Shubman Gill flicks it down to the fielder at long on. A single is taken!
Tosses it up, full and around off. Shubman Gill drives it to the fielder at mid off.
This one comes in with the arm, fuller one and around the leg pole. Shubman Gill advances down the pitch and looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Dot to end the over! On a length, around middle. Shreyas Iyer pushes it back to the bowler. A tidy over from Kyle Mayers!
Much fuller this time, around off. Shreyas Iyer drives it firmly but finds the fielder at mid off.
On a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point.
Leg bye! Slightly short now, around middle and leg. Shubman Gill looks to pull this one but he misses. The ball deflects off his thigh pad and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
Quick single! On a length once again, outside off. Shreyas Iyer cuts it towards cover-point and scampers across to the other end.
Good-length delivery, around off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it off the back foot towards the fielder at cover.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Shubman Gill drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Slower this time, full and outside off. Shreyas Iyer drives it down to long off for a single.
Outside off now, shortish ball. Shubman Gill cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Shorter one now, spinning away, around off. Shubman Gill knocks it towards mid on off the back foot.
FOUR! Top shot from Shubman Gill! Tosses it up, full and outside off. Shubman Gill gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Akeal Hosein begins with a fuller ball, quicker as well, at 89 clicks, around off. Shreyas Iyer drives it through cover for a single.
Akeal Hosein comes into the attack!
Back of a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer punches it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single. 6 runs off Kyle Mayers' first over!
Once again on the pads, a length ball. Shubman Gill tucks it through square leg and takes another run.
Slightly short now, darting it on the thigh pad. Shreyas Iyer flicks it through square leg for a single.
On a length, width on offer now. Shreyas Iyer cuts it past point for a brace. He gets off the mark with that!
On a length again, around off. Shubman Gill pushes it towards long on off the back foot. Single taken!
Kyle Mayers begins with a length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Shubman Gill looks to flick this but he gets an inside edge back ono his pads.
Shreyas Iyer walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunning catch to dismiss the Indian captain! Romario Shepherd draws first blood and breaks this opening stand. He drops it short again, outside off this time. Shikhar Dhawan leans back and uppercuts it towards third man. Kyle Mayers runs across to his right, dives, and takes a terrific catch. India lose their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Ouch! A shorter ball, around middle. Shikhar Dhawan steps down the pitch and looks to pull this one but he misses and gets hit on his helmet. He seems fins though!
On a length now, around middle and leg. Shubman Gill knocks it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Back of a length, around middle and off. Shubman Gill pulls it over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.

Tight single! On a length, outside off. Shikhar Dhawan walks across and taps it towards point. They scamper across to steal a quick single. Hayden Walsh collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end, but he misses.
On a length, around middle and 131 clicks. Romario Shepherd defends this one out.
Time for Powerplay 2! West Indies are now allowed to place 4 fielders outside the inner circle till the 40th over!

Gets away with the last ball but end of a really good over from Seales! On the pads, Gill flicks but to the short fine leg fielder. A sedate Powerplay 1 for the visitors. They are 42 for 0. They need another 270 in 240.
Just the single! One run off the over with a ball to go! Shorter and on off, this is guided through point for one.

We are ready for play to resume! The weather does not look threatening, the sun is shining for now, and let's hope it stays that way. Shikhar Dhawan and Shubman Gill will continue their batting. Jayden Seales will complete his over. Let's go!
UPDATE - 12.23 am IST (6.53 pm GMT, previous day) - We have good news, folks! The covers are coming off and we should be resuming anytime now.

UPDATE 12.11 am IST (6.41 pm GMT, previous day) - RAIN STOPS PLAY! It has started to drizzle and the covers are coming on! The players have made their way out off the field. The good news is that it's only a slight drizzle for now and it's not looking that threatening.
4 dots in a row! Pressure building on Dhawan! Length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
On the bounce to the fielder! Shorter and around off, Dhawan looks to slap it but is a touch early in the shot, he ends up hitting it towards mid off but it lands short of the fielder.
Dhawan steps out, Seales sticks to bowling it on a length. Dhawan pulls but to mid-wicket.
Extra bounce! Shorter and outside off, angling away. Dhawan slashges at it but misses.
A dot to end! On middle, Gill works it to mid-wicket.
Good running again! On a length and around off, this is pushed to the right of mid off for a single.
Good fielding by the Windies skipper! On middle, this is pushed to mid on. Pooran runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to one again.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, Gill pulls it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Dhawan is eyeing the on side but as the Windies bowlers see him move across, they go wide outside off. It is jammed through point for one.
On the pads, Gill works it towards short fine leg. The fielder dives and keeps it down to one.
Yes, he does. A really good slower one. On middle, Dhawan checks his shot and plays it to mid on.
Just the single! On middle, Gill pushes it to mid on and gets to the other end. Can Seales close the over out well?
Shortish and outside off, Gill looks to cut but underedges it on the off side.
Another one on a length and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Short, Gill pulls it nicely by getting on top of the bounce but to mid-wicket.
Well bowled again! Dhawan shuffles right across, this is bowled full and outside off, it is carved through point for one.
Yes, he does! Attacks the stumps, does not let the batter free his arms. It is worked to mid-wicket.
Fails to beat point! Length and on off, Gill opens the face of the bat but finds point. Can Romario Shepherd end the over well now?
On the pads, Dhawan works it through square leg and takes one.
Dhawan now skips down the track again, this is bowled on his pad. Dhawan looks to flick but misses. Dhawan looking to step on the gas now.
Excellent cricket all around! Dhawan steps out, this is on a length and around off, it is pushed down the ground. Pooran runs after it from wide mid off and keeps it down to two.
Short and outside off, Gill plays it through point for one. The man in the deep does well to move to his left and keep it down to a single.
Romario Shepherd comes into the attack. He replaces Alzarri Joseph.
Two dots to end but still a good over for India! Back of a length and on off, Dhawan plays it to mid off.
Another back of a length ball on off, Dhawan keeps it out.
Quick single! Length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Fails to find the gap! Shorter and outside off, Gill cuts but finds the man at point. He is disappointed. He had a chance to put that away.
Two more! On middle, Gill clips it past mid-wicket and takes two more.

FOUR! Put away! That is bread and butter for Gill! On the pads, this is worked past the fielder at short fine leg and this one races away to the fence. Good start to the over. Pressure on the bowler now.
Two more! On the pads, Dhawan clips it through mid-wicket and takes two.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Another one on a length and around off, Dhawan waits and then plays it to covers.
Another quick run! Length and on off, Gill pushes it to mid off and gets to the other end.

Dhawan was struggling to complete the second! On middle, this is worked past the mid-wicket fielder. Pooran from mid on runs after it. He picks the ball up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Dhawan was well out had he hit.
On middle, Dhawan works it towards mid on and takes one.
A good over despite going for a boundary early on by Seales! Length and on off, this is guided to point.
Good length and on off, Gill pushes it to mid off.
This one does not bounce a lot! Shorter and outside off, Gill looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Well fielded! Shorter and on middle, Gill pulls but the fielder at mid-wicket dives to his right and makes a decent stop.
FOUR! A very authoritative stroke! Gill takes a few steps down the track, this is on a length and on off. Gill shows the full face of the bat and strokes it down the ground to the long off fence.
Length and on off, blocked.
A good delivery to end from Joseph! Length and on off, Dhawan gets his bat down in time and defends it.
Another easy run! Length and on off, Gill opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for one.
That would have been very close! Length and on off, Dhawan pushes it to mid off and takes off. Pooran picks the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Dhawan was a goner.
Follows the boundary with a single as this is pushed through covers.

FOUR! That has been tickled very fine and India bag their first boundary of the chase. Comes off the bat of Gill. On the pads, he works it fine and this one races away to the fence. Failed to adjust this time to the right-left combination.
JUST WIDE! Length and on off, Shikhar looks to push at it, it flies off the outside edge past Mayers who dives to his left at first slip. It goes down to third man for one.
Dot to end then! Length and on off, Gill guides it to point.
Two more! Angled into the pads, Gill shuffles across and works it through square leg for two.
India and Gill are underway! Length and on off, Gill steps out and then guides it past point for two.
Make that 9 dots in a row! On middle, on a length, Gill works it to mid on.
Excellent from Seales! Gets this one to shape back in a touch, the length is good and the line is on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Really good start from Seales too! Length and on off, shaping away a touch. It is defended to mid off.
Jayden Seales will bowl from the other end.
Yes, he does! Really good start! Fuller and on off, Dhawan pushes it to mid off.
Another dot! On middle, this is played to mid on. Can Joseph start off with a maiden?
Brilliant fielding! West Indies are up for this! Shorter and on off, Dhawan guides it towards point. Walsh dives to his left and saves at least two.
Soft leading edge! Fuller, this one shapes away. Dhawan looks to work it on the leg side which is against the movement. It goes off a soft leading edge towards short point.
Another back of a length delivery and on off, Dhawan guides it to point.
Back of a length to begin with, on the off pole, Dhawan plays it to point.
